mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing one excitatory input with two aligned inputs made threshold and summation concrete; the explanation that the outgoing spike is a new event also clarified synaptic transmission.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final grey-matter construction was less informative: its planned picture shows a mesh of cells and contacts, but does not explain much about how the separate arrangements become that tissue.

surprise.text: With simultaneous excitatory and inhibitory inputs, the receiving-cell trace dipped below resting voltage rather than merely showing a smaller excitatory rise.

arbitrary.text: Combining two network arrangements to make grey matter felt somewhat abstract; the compatibility feedback supplied the partner, but the construction itself did not explain the connection in detail.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the contrasting spike responses made the constructions useful for reasoning about neural signals, although I would want fuller explanations of the tissue-level connections.
